title: Altar Abandonment & Rejection
hook: LADY JULIANA: 'And I am what?' — Clarissa gloats: 'You are the daughter people tolerate.'
cliffhanger: Gerald calls Juliana low value; Juliana's knuckles whiten in defiance as string drone swells.

title: Altar Rescue & Shock Proposal
hook: Guards seize Juliana; scarred warrior intervenes with lethal grace.
cliffhanger: Scarred warrior drops to one knee with marriage proposal before the stunned altar.

title: Altar Marriage Consecration
hook: Juliana looks Gerald dead in the eye: 'I accept.'
cliffhanger: Priest pronounces them wed; Gerald and Clarissa erupt in fury.

title: Stepmother Mud Humiliation
hook: Stepmother throws late mother's treasured ledger into the muddy road.
cliffhanger: Alexander steps between them, lifts the ledger, and turns his blade.

title: Framed Grand Theft Watch
hook: Constable: 'Then you have nothing to fear' — searches cottage.
cliffhanger: Gold pocket watch dangles from Constable's hand; Gerald grins with sinister triumph.

title: Blackthorn Briars Ultimatum
hook: Clarissa presents sadistic ultimatum: retrieve signet ring from razor briars or husband hangs.
cliffhanger: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa; steps toward the frozen blackthorns barehanded.

title: Barehanded Briar Crawl
hook: Juliana crawls on knees through razor briars, blood dripping on white snow.
cliffhanger: Her bleeding fingers unearth the emerald signet ring beneath the roots.

title: Thug Interrogation & Vow
hook: Alexander pins masked thug by the throat: 'Who sent you?'
cliffhanger: Thug chokes out a noble name; slow cello swell holds into cut.

title: Chained Bride Cathedral Assault
hook: Juliana dragged in iron chains before sneering society.
cliffhanger: Deafening explosion shatters cathedral doors; smoke pours into sanctuary.

title: Cold Rejection of Villainess
hook: Catherine pleads on knees: 'I mourned you!'
cliffhanger: Alexander turns his back coldly and walks to chained Juliana at the doorway.
